name: r2-dispatch-incident
_comment: A malformed incident in a stored conditional control ends the Node-RED valve tick (parseControl runs parseIncident), so the due clock sync of another valve is not sent until the incident is valid.

steps.why: A FIXED control whose incident has an empty incident_id, and a WEEKLY valve due for its first clock sync.
